summary: All planned code and test changes for issue #411 are present and faithful to the locked design: the constant PRE_PUSH_VALIDATION_REPARENT_FAILED is added and re-exported, _head_preserves_fix_tree is removed while _head_descends_from is kept, _reparent_fix_pass_commit implements every planned step (both rev-parse tree guards, no-net-change guard, git log -1 message derivation with fallback, git_identity_config_args() in commit-tree, reset --hard, and secret-safe warnings with git_step + truncated stderr), the if-not-committed branch is rewritten to always re-parent non-descendant rewrites, the loop failure-label mapping adds 'reparent failed', and monitor.pre_push_validation_fix_reparented is emitted. Tests are rewritten/renamed/deleted in part_001 and a new part_003 covers all planned reparent scenarios (success+identity, rev-parse failures, no-net-change, commit-tree failure, reset failure, message fallback, reset+recommit drop, reparent-failed reason, loop re-validation, and loop label mapping); all _parts files stay under the 1500-line maintainability cap. The implementation matches the plan; the only remaining gap is the absence of AWF-owned validation evidence, which conformance is not permitted to generate.
gaps: No AWF-owned validation evidence exists in the workspace (no pytest, ruff check, ruff format --check, mypy, or targeted coverage artifacts/logs). AWF should run the focused validation suite from the plan (the test_pr_monitor_pre_push_validation* suites + test_core_decomposition_maintainability, ruff/format on the changed paths, mypy, and --cov=awf.runtime.pr_monitor_runner.pre_push_validation) to confirm tests pass and the 99% coverage gate holds for the new _reparent_fix_pass_commit branches and rewritten if-not-committed block.
